::: {#sol-load-digits}

```{python}
#| code-fold: false
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

digits = pd.read_csv("data/optdigits-test.csv", header=None)
print(digits.shape)

# Columns 0 to 63 are the pixels; column 64 is the digit.
pixels = digits.iloc[:, :64].to_numpy()
labels = digits[64].to_numpy()
digit_counts = np.bincount(labels)
print(digit_counts)
```

The file holds `r nrow(py$digits)` images,
between `r min(py$digit_counts)` and `r max(py$digit_counts)` of each digit.

:::
